executive_summary: Revise. The frozen candidate digest and all 133 evidence-manifest entries verify byte-for-byte, and the open ADP/ISM provenance feedback was materially remediated: Trading Economics is consistently identified for displayed values while official probes are non-value probes. Official policy facts, Fed proxy arithmetic and explicit non-CME distinction, CRAU26 fields and multi-meeting limitation, aligned CPI tuples, zero-weight tombstones, cash-session cutoff, and visible-price calculations are otherwise reproducible. However, the weighted Ivey driver lacks a source-observation timestamp and an explicit field-level evidence mapping, and the BoC pricing proxy_source_url is mislabeled as a BoC Valet URL although the observable proxy is the TMX CRA quote. These provenance/freshness defects prevent unconditional P&L approval.

findings.issue: The weighted Ivey PMI driver has no source_observed_at_toronto or observed_at_toronto field and is not given a dedicated evidence-chain mapping in pm-handoff.json. Its generic TradingEconomics calendar URL identifies a landing page rather than the exact event/value record. The displayed 64.3 Actual, 56.2 Forecast, and 55.1 Previous therefore cannot be independently tied to a timestamped frozen provider record at review time.
findings.evidence: candidate.json contains boc_hawk_ivey_20260904 with weight 1.5, published_at_toronto 2026-09-04T10:00:00-04:00, source_url https://tradingeconomics.com/calendar, and no observed_at_toronto or source_observed_at_toronto. The handoff field_by_field_remediation_evidence_mapping covers ADP, ISM, whole-candidate consistency, and older invariants, but contains no Ivey mapping; the manifest only includes the broad tradingeconomics-calendar.html artifact without a field-level Ivey reference.
findings.pnl_impact: A 1.5-weight hawkish activity signal can alter the BoC balance and influence CAD, front-end rates, and duration decisions. Without a timestamped exact evidence chain, the PM cannot distinguish the stated Ivey release tuple from a stale, revised, or differently defined calendar row.
findings.instruction: Recollect the exact Ivey PMI provider record and add a matching frozen evidence artifact or precise existing artifact mapping. Add source_observed_at_toronto, preserve the release timestamp, identify the exact provider URL/record for Actual/Forecast/Previous, and re-evaluate the hawkish side and 1.5 weight before rebuilding the whole candidate and recomputing its SHA-256.

findings.issue: The field named proxy_source_url points to the Bank of Canada CORRA Valet series, while the stated observable pricing proxy is the TMX/MX CRAU26 quote. This is a source-label mismatch in the BoC pricing block even though source_url and observable_proxy.source_url correctly point to TMX.
findings.evidence: candidate.json meetings.boc.pricing.source says TMX/MX CRA quarterly CORRA futures observable and source_url is https://www.m-x.ca/en/trading/data/quotes?symbol=CRA%2A, but proxy_source_url is https://www.bankofcanada.ca/valet/observations/AVG.INTWO/json?start_date=2026-09-01. The CRA quote evidence verifies the 97.595 last, 97.595 bid x 20, 97.600 ask x 175, settlement 97.6000, volume 197, OI 230466, and 6 trades; the BoC URL is the separate CORRA reference series, not the CRA quote source.
findings.pnl_impact: A PM following proxy_source_url could retrieve CORRA rather than the quoted CRAU26 instrument and fail to reproduce the displayed price, liquidity, and quarterly-average inference. That creates avoidable misidentification risk in BoC front-end and CAD positioning decisions.
findings.instruction: Align proxy_source_url with the TMX/MX CRA quote source, or rename and clearly separate the CORRA reference-series field from the instrument source. Rebuild and re-hash the candidate, then submit a fresh independent review with the corrected provenance and evidence mapping.
